text_en: After many days the word of the Lord came to Elijah, in the third year of the drought, saying, “Go, present yourself to Ahab; I will send rain on the earth. ”
text_cn: 过了许多时日，到了第三年，有上主的话传于厄里亚说：“你去见阿哈布，我要在这地上降雨。”

text_en: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.
text_cn: 厄里亚就去见阿哈布；那时，撒玛黎雅正遭受严重的饥荒。

text_en: Ahab summoned Obadiah, who was in charge of the palace. (Now Obadiah revered the Lord greatly;
text_cn: 阿哈布将自己的家宰敖巴狄雅召来，──敖巴狄雅原是一位很敬畏上主的人。

text_en: when Jezebel was killing off the prophets of the Lord , Obadiah took a hundred prophets, hid them fifty to a cave, and provided them with bread and water. )
text_cn: 当依则贝耳杀害上主的先知时，他曾收留了一百个先知，每五十人分藏在一个洞里，私下供给他们饮食。──

text_en: Then Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land to all the springs of water and to all the wadis; perhaps we may find grass to keep the horses and mules alive, and not lose some of the animals. ”
text_cn: 阿哈布对敖巴狄雅说：“我们要走遍这地，到所有的水泉和小河那里去，或许能找到一些青草，使骡马生存，免得丧失许多牲畜。”

text_en: So they divided the land between them to pass through it; Ahab went in one direction by himself, and Obadiah went in another direction by himself.
text_cn: 他们于是分地巡行：阿哈布独自走了一条路，敖巴狄雅也独自走了另一条路。

text_en: As Obadiah was on the way, Elijah met him; Obadiah recognized him, fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah? ”
text_cn: 敖巴狄雅走路时，厄里亚恰巧遇见了他；敖巴狄雅认得他，便俯伏在地说：“你不就是我主厄里亚吗？”

text_en: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord that Elijah is here. ”
text_cn: 厄里亚回答说：“是，你去告诉你的主人说：厄里亚在这里。”

text_en: And he said, “How have I sinned, that you would hand your servant over to Ahab, to kill me?
text_cn: 敖巴狄雅说：“我犯了什么罪？你竟要将你的仆人交于阿哈布手中，让他杀死我？

text_en: As the Lord your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom to which my lord has not sent to seek you; and when they would say, ‘He is not here, ’ he would require an oath of the kingdom or nation, that they had not found you.
text_cn: 我指着永生的上主，你的天主起誓：没有一个民族，没有一个国家，我的主上不派人去寻找你的；如果人们说：厄里亚不在我们这里；他一定要叫那个国家和那个民族起誓说：实在他们没有找到你。

text_en: But now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord that Elijah is here. ’
text_cn: 现在你说：你去告诉你的主人说：厄里亚在这里。

text_en: As soon as I have gone from you, the spirit of the Lord will carry you I know not where; so, when I come and tell Ahab and he cannot find you, he will kill me, although I your servant have revered the Lord from my youth.
text_cn: 我一离开你，上主的神把你带到我所不知道的地方去；我若去告诉阿哈布，而他找不到你，岂不要杀死我？你的仆人自幼也是个敬畏上主的人啊！

text_en: Has it not been told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the prophets of the Lord , how I hid a hundred of the Lord ’s prophets fifty to a cave, and provided them with bread and water?
text_cn: 难道我主没有听说过：当依则贝耳残杀上主的先知时，我所作的事？我曾隐藏一百个上主的先知，每五十人分藏在一个洞里，由我供给他们饮食。

text_en: Yet now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord that Elijah is here’; he will surely kill me. ”
text_cn: 现在你说：你去告诉你的主人，厄里亚在这里，他一定要杀我！”

text_en: Elijah said, “As the Lord of hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today. ”
text_cn: 厄里亚说：“我指着我所服侍的万军的永生上主起誓：今天我一定要叫阿哈布看见我。”

text_en: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
text_cn: 敖巴狄雅于是前去会见阿哈布，告诉了他这消息，阿哈布就去迎接厄里亚。

text_en: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is it you, you troubler of Israel? ”
text_cn: 阿哈布一见厄里亚，就对他说：“叫以色列遭难的人，不就是你吗？”

text_en: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel; but you have, and your father’s house, because you have forsaken the commandments of the Lord and followed the Baals.
text_cn: 厄里亚答说：“不是我叫以色列遭难，而是你和你的父家，因为你们抛弃了上主的诫命，归顺了巴耳邪神。

text_en: Now therefore have all Israel assemble for me at Mount Carmel, with the four hundred fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table. ”
text_cn: 现在，你派人去召集全以色列人，同受依则贝耳供养的那四百五十个巴耳的先知，【及那四百个阿舍辣的先知，】上加尔默耳山，到我跟前来。”

text_en: So Ahab sent to all the Israelites, and assembled the prophets at Mount Carmel.
text_cn: 阿哈布便派人召集了所有的以色列子民，聚集了那些先知，一起到了加尔默耳山上。

text_en: Elijah then came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you go limping with two different opinions? If the Lord is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him. ” The people did not answer him a word.
text_cn: 厄里亚走向全体民众面前说：“你们摇摆不定，模棱两可，要到几时呢？如果上主是天主，你们就应该随从上主；如果巴耳是天主，就该随从巴耳。”人民一句话也不回答。

text_en: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left a prophet of the Lord ; but Baal’s prophets number four hundred fifty.
text_cn: 厄里亚对人民说：“上主的先知只剩下我一个人了，巴耳的先知却有四百五十人。

text_en: Let two bulls be given to us; let them choose one bull for themselves, cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, but put no fire to it; I will prepare the other bull and lay it on the wood, but put no fire to it.
text_cn: 请给我们牵两只公牛犊来；他们可任选一只，剖分成块，放在木柴上，不要点火；我也照样预备另一只，放在木柴上，也不点火。

text_en: Then you call on the name of your god and I will call on the name of the Lord ; the god who answers by fire is indeed God. ” All the people answered, “Well spoken! ”
text_cn: 你们呼求你们神的名字，我也呼求上主的名字：那降火显示应允的神，就是真神。”民众回答说：“你这话说得很好！”

text_en: Then Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose for yourselves one bull and prepare it first, for you are many; then call on the name of your god, but put no fire to it. ”
text_cn: 厄里亚对巴耳的先知们说：“因为你们人数众多，你们该先挑选一只牛犊，准备好，然后呼求你们神的名字，只是不要点火。”

text_en: So they took the bull that was given them, prepared it, and called on the name of Baal from morning until noon, crying, “O Baal, answer us! ” But there was no voice, and no answer. They limped about the altar that they had made.
text_cn: 他们即将人给他们的公牛犊牵来，预备好，从早晨直到中午呼求巴耳的名字说：“巴耳，应允我们吧！”但是没有声音，也没有答应的。他们就在自己所筑的祭坛旁，跪下又起来，跳个不停。

text_en: At noon Elijah mocked them, saying, “Cry aloud! Surely he is a god; either he is meditating, or he has wandered away, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he is asleep and must be awakened. ”
text_cn: 到了中午，厄里亚嘲弄他们说：“你们再高声喊叫，因为他是神，或者他正在沉思冥想，或者他暂时隐退，或者正在外旅行，或者他正在睡觉，必须把他叫醒。”

text_en: Then they cried aloud and, as was their custom, they cut themselves with swords and lances until the blood gushed out over them.
text_cn: 他们遂更高声喊叫，照他们的习惯，用刀用枪割伤自己，直到全身流出血来。

text_en: As midday passed, they raved on until the time of the offering of the oblation, but there was no voice, no answer, and no response.
text_cn: 过了中午，他们仍继续狂喊乱叫，直到晚祭的时候，但仍然没有声音，也没有答应的，也没有理会的。

text_en: Then Elijah said to all the people, “Come closer to me”; and all the people came closer to him. First he repaired the altar of the Lord that had been thrown down;
text_cn: 厄里亚对全体人民说：“你们到我这边来。”全体人民便都到他那边去；厄里亚立即重修了已经坍塌了的上主的祭坛；

text_en: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the Lord came, saying, “Israel shall be your name”;
text_cn: 依照雅各伯子孙的支派数目，取了十二块石头，──这雅各伯就是上主曾对他说过：“你的名字要叫以色列。”──

text_en: with the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord . Then he made a trench around the altar, large enough to contain two measures of seed.
text_cn: 用这些石头，为上主的名筑成一座祭坛，在祭坛四周作了一个水沟，可容二"色阿"谷种。

text_en: Next he put the wood in order, cut the bull in pieces, and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood. ”
text_cn: 把木柴放好，将牛犊剖分成块，放在木柴上，

text_en: Then he said, “Do it a second time”; and they did it a second time. Again he said, “Do it a third time”; and they did it a third time,
text_cn: 然后吩咐说：“盛满四桶水，倒在全燔祭和木柴上！”他们就这样做了。他又吩咐说：“再倒一次！”他们就再倒了一次；他再吩咐说：“倒第三次！”他们就倒了第三次；

text_en: so that the water ran all around the altar, and filled the trench also with water.
text_cn: 水沿祭坛四周奔流，沟里满了水。

text_en: At the time of the offering of the oblation, the prophet Elijah came near and said, “O Lord , God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, let it be known this day that you are God in Israel, that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your bidding.
text_cn: 到了要奉献晚祭的时候，厄里亚先知走近前来说：“上主，亚巴郎、依撒格和以色列的天主，求你今天使人知道：你是以色列的天主，我是你的仆人，是奉你的命作这一切事。

text_en: Answer me, O Lord , answer me, so that this people may know that you, O Lord , are God, and that you have turned their hearts back. ”
text_cn: 上主，求你应允我，应允我！使这人民知道你上主，是真天主，是你叫他们心回意转。”

text_en: Then the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust, and even licked up the water that was in the trench.
text_cn: 于是上主的火降下，焚尽了全燔祭、柴木、石头和尘土，也烧干了沟中的水。

text_en: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces and said, “The Lord indeed is God; the Lord indeed is God. ”
text_cn: 全体人民见了，都俯伏在地说：“雅威是天主，雅威是天主！”

text_en: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal; do not let one of them escape. ” Then they seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the Wadi Kishon, and killed them there.
text_cn: 厄里亚对民众说：“你们捉住巴耳的先知，不要让他们走脱一个！”民众立即捉住他们。厄里亚带他们下到克雄小河旁，在那里将他们全部杀掉。

text_en: Elijah said to Ahab, “Go up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of rushing rain. ”
text_cn: 厄里亚对阿哈布说：“你上去吃喝吧！因为已听到大雨的怒号声。”

text_en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; there he bowed himself down upon the earth and put his face between his knees.
text_cn: 阿哈布就上去吃喝，厄里亚却上了加尔默耳山顶，跪伏在地，将脸放在两膝之间。

text_en: He said to his servant, “Go up now, look toward the sea. ” He went up and looked, and said, “There is nothing. ” Then he said, “Go again seven times. ”
text_cn: 以后，对自己的仆人说：“你上去，朝海那边观看！”仆人就上去观看，说：“什么也没有。”厄里亚说：“你来回观看七次！”他就去了七次。

text_en: At the seventh time he said, “Look, a little cloud no bigger than a person’s hand is rising out of the sea. ” Then he said, “Go say to Ahab, ‘Harness your chariot and go down before the rain stops you. ’”
text_cn: 第七次仆人说：“看，有一片云彩，小得像人手掌那么大，从海上升起来了。”厄里亚说：“你上去告诉阿哈布说：快套车下去，免得被雨阻止！”

text_en: In a little while the heavens grew black with clouds and wind; there was a heavy rain. Ahab rode off and went to Jezreel.
text_cn: 转瞬之间，天空因风云而变为昏黑，落下大雨；阿哈布上车去了依次勒耳。

text_en: But the hand of the Lord was on Elijah; he girded up his loins and ran in front of Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
text_cn: 上主的手临于厄里亚身上，他就束上腰，跑在阿哈布前头，直到依次勒耳的城门口。
